# Physical-risk asset (`physical-asset` v1)

A counterparty's physical asset and its exposure to floods, heat, storms and wildfire.

**Group:** Climate · **Mnemonic:** `PHY` · **Identifiers:** `PHY-…` in `assetId`

Open one with `PHY <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: physical-asset
version: 1
description: "A counterparty's physical asset and its exposure to floods, heat, storms and wildfire."
match: { kind: physical-asset, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Climate · Physical-risk asset, id: $.assetId }
strip:
  - { label: Asset, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Owner, bind: $.counterpartyName }
  - { label: Country, bind: $.country }
  - { label: Value, bind: $.value, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Worst hazard, bind: $.worstHazard, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Insured, bind: $.insured, fmt: pct0 }
panels:
  - id: hazards
    kind: hbar
    title: "Hazard scores (0-100, 2050, RCP 4.5)"
    key: F2
    rows: $.hazards
    label: hazard
    value: score
    fmt: amount0
  - id: location
    kind: kv
    title: Location
    area: right
    rows: $.location
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.counterparty, 'counterparty')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
